2611.13289.title: MRFoundry: Knowledge-guided agent loops for end-to-end MRI research
2611.13289.paper_summary: AI agents can write code, use scientific software, and revise computational workflows, opening new possibilities for MRI research. Effective assistance requires connecting acquisition physics, data conventions, specialized tools, and scientific validation. We present MRFoundry, an open-source, extensible package that connects MRI knowledge to agent actions and output checks. Project-local memory preserves decisions and evidence, while reviewed contributions allow researchers to improve shared guidance. Researcher-supervised examples demonstrate skill-guided sequence auditing and acquired-data reconstruction, connecting tool use, output checks, and documented decisions. Alongside MRFoundry, we introduce MRI Agent Bench to compare agents with and without the package across models and MRI task domains. Across 240 paired Core evaluations spanning 24 task types and ten models, all-checks-passed completion increased from 67.5% without MRFoundry to 78.3% with it. Across 134 Hard pairs, completion increased from 36.6% to 44.8%. MRFoundry makes MRI workflow expertise available as reusable guidance that researchers can inspect, adapt, and extend within existing agent and scientific software environments. MRFoundry is openly available at https://github.com/KeWang0622/MRFoundry.
